text.description_html:
Pemko 36" Surface Mounted Automatic Door Bottom Seal

Surface mounted (screws to the door face) automatic door bottom seal kit. Smoother action positive seal mechanism. All Pemko automatic door bottoms consist of an aluminum case which surrounds a movable drop-bar seal. The drop-bar seal is actuated by a plunger which contacts the jamb as the door is closing, forcing the drop-bar seal down against the floor / threshold.

Field sizable 2" (you can only shorten it a total of 2 inches). Powder coated non-rusting aluminum blade housing. Packaged with installation screws.

Specifications for Pemko 412DRL-36 Automatic Door Bottom Seal

  • Length: 36"
  • Total Height: 1-15/16"
  • Projection: 9/16"
  • Max Door Gap to Floor: 5/8"
  • Seal Type: Black Sponge Neoprene
  • Handed, Reversible
  • Finish: Dark Bronze
  • Pemko 412DRL Installation

Special order item, please allow 10-14 days to ship. Made to order in any size ranging from 18" to 72". Please Contact Us with your requirements.

*Sold Individually.
